title: Dispatch: author the twelve W7 diagnostic fixtures and the fixture contract (attempt 1)
description:

first: it carries the OWNER / SCOPE / REQUIRED STATEMENTS / NON-GOALS /
ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA that govern this work. This bead carries the implementation
plan only.

Authority: `docs/audits/rules-awareness-transition/2026-07-30-integrated-transition-design.md`
sections 6.1 (diagnostic-fixture identity), 6.2 (route classes), 6.3 (priority
bands), 10 (the twelve probes), 11 (the thirteen-field fixture contract), 14 (W7).
ADR 0020 controls. Read sections 6, 10, and 11 in full before writing anything.

BRANCH / WORKTREE

parent branch `eshyra-o9bd.19.9` at `22c1a04`. Work only inside that worktree;
`cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"` after entering it.

DELIVERABLE SHAPE (test-scoped; the parent bead forbids production code,
generated pack data, and schema changes)

    packages/core/test/diagnostics/fixtureContract.ts
    packages/core/test/diagnostics/probes/p01Cover.ts … p12StartingWealth.ts
    packages/core/test/diagnostics/index.ts
    packages/core/test/diagnosticFixtureCorpus.test.ts

`packages/core/test/**` is NOT covered by `tsc --build` (packages/core/tsconfig.json
includes only `src`), so types alone enforce nothing at build time. The corpus
must therefore ship a runtime validator that the test invokes, in the style of
`validateFindingRegistry` in `packages/core/src/rules/findingRegistry.ts` (read it
and `packages/core/test/findingRegistry.test.ts` first — that pair is the house
pattern for a truthful, self-checking registry artifact and this work should read
like it). Biome does cover the new files; `npm run format` before committing.

1. `fixtureContract.ts`
   - `DiagnosticFixture` interface with exactly the thirteen section-11 fields
     plus the fourteenth `expectedDeterministicStateEffect`, named in section-11
     order: `playerInput`, `campaignState`, `adventureState`, `campaignRuleState`,
     `mustIncludeTargets`, `mayIncludeTargets`, `mustNotIncludeTargets`,
     `expectedRouteClasses`, `requiredRetainedFacts`,
     `requiredRelationshipExpansion`, `expectedAmbiguityState`,
     `expectedCampaignRuleOrRulingState`, `expectedCapabilityStatus`,
     `expectedDeterministicStateEffect`. Fields 3, 4, 10, 11, 12 must be
     expressible as an explicit "none" that is a value, never `undefined` — an
     absent field and a declared absence must not be confusable.
   - Per-fixture metadata: `probeId` (`P1`…`P12`), `title`,
     `verifiedAtCommit` (the exact SHA the identities were verified at — use the
     worktree's merge-base with origin/main, i.e. `22c1a04bfe2a3c6c68675e3e31879bfbfd17fc98`,
     unless you re-verify at a later SHA, in which case record that one),
     `gatingBlocker` (`'B1'|'B2'|'B3'|'B4'|'B5'|'none'` plus the owning bead id and
     what the blocker gates), and `boundedEvidenceStatement` (in-band prose, per
     fixture, stating that the fixture is bounded evidence for its named scenario
     and is not a completeness unit, a partition of the corpus, or an input to any
     coverage/readiness/completeness figure).
   - `oracleSignals`: every signal the fixture supplies to a downstream stage
     rather than expecting the stage to derive, each labelled with what it
     supplies and why, so a downstream pass on a supplied answer can never be
     reported as end-to-end success. Fixtures with none declare an empty list
     explicitly.
   - Target/selector identity per section 6.1: canonical `RulesRecord.key`,
     `provenance.sourceRef`, `provenance.locator`, narrowed only by a test-local
     selector of one of the four permitted forms — JSON pointer, existing
     ambiguity id, existing operation or compiler-emitted clause id, or a narrowly
     described source-text predicate carrying its exact expected substring. Model
     the selector as a discriminated union with exactly those four variants and no
     fifth. Where the pack carries only `data.text` (`rule:cover`,
     `rule:opportunity-attacks`, `rule:concentration` — all three verified
     `{ text }`-only at 22c1a04), use the source-text-predicate form; do not invent
     a JSON pointer.
   - `RouteClass` union: exactly the nine of section 6.2 —
     `direct-state-ref`, `direct-adventure-ref`, `explicit-name-or-alias`,
     `typed-relationship`, `situation-cue`, `auditor-missing-target`,
     `campaign-rule`, `campaign-ruling`, `capability-preflight`. Document in-band
     that these are diagnostic labels for why a candidate was proposed, not a
     closed or universal relationship vocabulary.
   - `CORPUS_NON_CLAIMS`: an explicit list of what the corpus does not claim
     (no universal clause ontology, no universal obligation identity — that stays
     eshyra-o9bd.19.1.14's question — no closed relationship vocabulary, no corpus
     partition, no coverage or completeness figure, no claim that a selector's
     absence means the material is absent). Mirror `explicitNonClaims` in
     findingRegistry.
   - `validateDiagnosticCorpus(fixtures)`: throws on a missing or empty
     contract field, a duplicate or missing probe id, a selector outside the four
     permitted forms, a missing `verifiedAtCommit`, a missing bounded-evidence
     statement, an unlabelled oracle signal, or an unknown route class.

   `packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1/records.json` and
   `packages/core/data/adventure-modules/eshyra_hollow-beneath-emberfall/adventure-module.json`
   in this worktree before you write it down. The supervisor's own verification at
   22c1a04 is recorded below as a starting point — confirm each yourself, and where
   this plan and the pack disagree, the pack wins and you state the correction
   in-band.

   P1 `rule:cover`, kind `rule`, locator `p. 96`. `data` is `{ text }` only.
     Player text must never contain the word "cover"; the scenario is the PC
     ducking behind a low wall and firing across a courtyard at a sentry. Route
     `situation-cue` (geometry + combat context). Capability status: no capability
     positively selected — `ENGINE_PROCEDURE_COVERAGE['rule:cover']` in
     `packages/core/scripts/create-dnd5e-srd-audit-bundle/ruleDispositions.ts` is
     `model-adjudicated-supported`, primitives `['lookup_rules','resolve_check']`,
     contextRequirement naming degree-of-cover selection and the ±2/±5 AC and
     Dex-save bonuses riding `resolve_check` declared modifiers. Must-not-include:
     any claim that a cover bonus was applied deterministically.
   P2 `rule:opportunity-attacks`, locator `p. 95`, `{ text }` only. Retrieval
     from movement intent, not a rule-name mention. Required retained facts: the
     trigger clause AND all three exception clauses (Disengage, teleport,
     involuntary movement) as source-text predicates with exact substrings. A
     packet carrying the trigger but dropping an exception is a recorded failure.
     Coverage entry is `model-adjudicated-supported`, primitives
     `['lookup_rules','roll','spend_turn_resource']`, contextRequirement
     "trigger/exclusion ruling; the reaction spend is code-owned (F2 turn budget)".
   P3 `creature:adult-black-dragon`, locator `p. 281`, selector JSON pointer
     `/data/actions/5` — verified as "Acid Breath (Recharge 5–6)"; `data.actions`
     has 6 entries. Required retained fact: the exact substring
     "or half as much damage on a successful one". The fixture must also assert
     that the typed projection omits it: the entry's `mechanics` carries
     `saves: [{ability:'dexterity', dc:18}]`, `damage: [{average:54, dice:'12d8',
     type:'acid'}]`, and `recharge: {roll:'d6', minimum:5, maximum:6}`, with NO
     `damageOnSuccess` and no success branch. Must-not-include: any presentation
     in which the typed projection suppresses or overwrites the faithful prose, or
     in which `12d8` reads as the unconditional outcome. No capability positively
     selected; damage arithmetic rides `resolve_damage`.
   P4 `spell:fireball`, locator `p. 144`. Verified projection:
     `mechanics.saves[0] = {ability:'dexterity', damageOnSuccess:'half'}`;
     `mechanics.damage = [{dice:'8d6', type:'fire'}]`;
     `mechanics.scaling.perSlot = {stat:'damage', increase:'1d6', baseSlotLevel:3}`;
     `data.upcast` with `clauseId: 'fireball:higher-slot'` and
     `disposition: 'complete-typed-upcast'`; and NO `mechanics.area` despite
     "a 20-foot-radius sphere" in `data.description`. Required retained facts: the
     20-foot-radius sphere as a source-text predicate with an explicit note that no
     typed area exists; the Dexterity save; 8d6 fire; "half as much damage on a
     successful one"; the per-slot scaling. Capability: the upcast path is consumed

   P5 `condition:incapacitated` (locator `p. 358`) and `rule:concentration`

   P7 `magic-item:cube-of-force`, locator `p. 215`, selector

HARD CONSTRAINTS (violating any of these fails the bead)
- No production code, generated pack data, or schema changes. Test-scoped only.
- No discovery implementation, no stage harness (that is W8, eshyra-o9bd.19.10),
  no runtime integration.
- No ranker, embedding model, vector database, or graph database.
- No finding is closed, retired, narrowed, or reclassified here.
- No fixture asserts a count of records.
- No fixture or test aggregates probes into a coverage, readiness, or
  completeness figure.
- The campaign-rule fixtures (P7, P10) consume eshyra-jhpt identities and define
  no second ruling model, schema, store, resolver, or lifecycle.
- Do not weaken or edit any existing test or audit expectation.
- Where the design and the pack disagree, the pack wins and the correction is
  stated in the fixture.
